summary: INNOVATE Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the completed sale of DBMG Global, Inc. to IES Holdings, Inc. for undisclosed terms, alongside multiple related events: termination of material agreements, executive changes, and Regulation FD disclosure. The filing dated October 5, 2026, did not disclose price per share, premium, or expected close date. In connection with the sale, INNOVATE repaid approximately $20.7 million under its MSD revolving credit facility and DBMG repaid approximately $68.7 million under its UMB credit agreement, terminating both. The board recommended the transaction. Risk-arb angle focuses on integrating the management changes and potential further restructuring.
